answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a deterministic RTOS time-triggered slot and a Byzantine-quorum attestation, so a forged node cannot reach the willow of consensus without a distinct hardware root. Colluding identities must each post an independent bond verified across the mesa of the flight control network, and only at the zenith of quorum. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
